svg.title: Folio today: processes, lanes, owners and crates
svg.desc: Folio at main b6ca4329 on 2026-09-23: the window process with its window thread and the threads of six other lanes, the processes that talk to it, the child processes it starts, and the crates the threads live in. Derived from the spawn and process-construction sites in the code.
svg.text: Folio today — processes, the seven lanes, the owners, and the crates they live in
main b6ca4329, 2026-09-23. Every thread and process drawn is a spawn or construction site found in the code; the census and how to repeat it are in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §0.
each one exits; none holds a window
